design.name: 飞廉
design.brief: Feilian (飞廉), the Wind Earl of Chinese myth: 'a deer's body, a head like a sparrow's, with horns, a snake's tail and leopard spots'. A large graceful beast about 4 m tall at the head, with a strong deer body and long legs, a big round sparrow-like bird head with a short stout beak and large dark eyes, a pair of branching antler-like horns, a tawny coat covered in dark leopard rosettes, and a long scaled snake tail ending in a fan of feathers. Wind is shown as solid sculpted swirling ribbon shapes coiling around its legs and tail (opaque, part of the design), threaded with magenta-violet lightning veins; a glowing magenta wind orb sits between the antler bases (weak spot). Lofty, wild and tempestuous.
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the earlier rosters (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast, huodou sighthound): chunky simplified masses, oversized heads and paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges. Lightning is painted as OPAQUE glowing magenta-violet zig-zag veins and solid sculpted spark shapes on the body (never transparent bolts, particles, smoke or glow halos); fur, hair and feathers as a few large carved clumps.
design.turnaround_pose: standing ON ALL FOURS like a tall stag (quadruped), the body level, the four long slender legs straight under the body and planted, front and hind legs separated with a gap of air; the head held up on its neck facing straight ahead with the beak closed; the branching antlers with EMPTY space between them: NO orb and NO sphere between the antlers (the wind orb is a separate effect); the long scaled snake tail extending straight back and slightly upward with its feather fan at the end (not curled); NO wind ribbons anywhere (the wind is a separate effect): the legs and the tail are bare and clearly visible; the lightning veins painted opaque (no halo)
design.turnaround_digits: each leg ends in a cloven hoof with two separate toes; the antler tips and the whole tail with its feather fan fully inside the frame; in the side views the long body and tail must fit inside the view with margin.
